content.text:
**Finding: compliant (preferred position).**

No Customer-side MFN exists. Section 12.3 expressly records that Customer has made no most-favoured-customer commitment, and neither pricing clause (§ 7.1 fixed Order Form Fees; § 8.3 capped renewal uplift) creates any obligation to disclose, match, or extend third-party terms to Vendor. Nothing to redline under MFN; the exclusivity, take-or-pay, and non-compete burdens I saw in §§ 2.1, 2.2 and 12.4 belong to other rules and are not double-flagged here.
